title: SA-2 surface-to-air missile on launcher (CIA U-2 history, Chapter 4)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a Soviet SA-2 missile mounted on a transporter/launcher vehicle in a snowy setting, captioned "SA-2 surface-to-air missile." Below, Chapter 4 text (page 171) discusses the lack of Soviet protest over the 9 April 1960 mission and planning for further overflights, including Operation SUN SPOT.
